notes: Single-threaded, one query at a time; query rotation and quantization are inside the timer, normalization is outside (as for the other systems).

Queries run single-threaded one at a time for every system; builds use all cores.
HMS takes dense input through its sparse encoder; its latency includes encoding (query_total).

hnswlib index_bytes is an estimate (vectors + level-0 links); FAISS sizes are serialized bytes; rabitqlib sizes are saved-index bytes; NGT is the index directory; Lucene is the on-heap graph plus the float vectors.
Extra systems (--extra) are timed by the same loop; Lucene runs its loop in Java (lucene_hnsw/).
